proof_summary: A residue-class sieve modulo $30030=2\cdot3\cdot5\cdot7\cdot11\cdot13$, whose coprime density is $5760/30030<1/5$, gives $\pi(5M)\le M$ for $M\ge10^6$; monotonicity below that threshold then makes the maximum of the initial values and $\pi(5\cdot10^6)$ an invariant upper bound. Hence only finitely many five-term windows can occur, so two coincide, and determinism of the recurrence propagates this equality forever with period equal to the gap between them.
